name: Singer and Guitarist

alt: A guitarist in a tan jacket playing an acoustic guitar on a bridge, with autumn trees behind him.
blurb: One voice and a guitar, singing the songs your guests know the words to, at a volume they can keep talking across. It books for a single hour or for arrival through dinner: welcome drinks, a cocktail hour on a patio, a dinner party at home, or a small wedding.
